answer: Each new account entering the orchard earns nectar only after staking reputation it cannot cheaply mint. A sybil farm at the inlet multiplies identities, but each must lock collateral that slashing destroys on detection. The attacker's gain: more reward shares. His loss: principal at risk, plus detection probability rising with clone count. Equilibrium: beyond a few copies, marginal nectar expected value turns negative, so rationals stop multiplying and the orchard stays honest.
